# Upstream paths intentionally NOT vendored into TruePad.
#
# Rationale: TruePad vendors swift-crypto to BUILD it, not to develop it. Copying
# upstream's own test corpus, benchmarks, CI and lint configuration would add
# ~35 MB of material that TruePad neither compiles nor reviews, and would make the
# real vendor delta harder to find. Every path below is upstream development or
# generated tooling, never a source of compiled code.
#
# verify-vendor.sh removes exactly these paths from a pristine upstream checkout
# before diffing, so a reviewer sees only the intentional patch.
#
# One path per line; '#' comments and blank lines ignored.

.git
.swiftpm
Tests
Benchmarks
dev
scripts
cmake
CMakeLists.txt
.github
.editorconfig
.gitattributes
.gitignore
.licenseignore
.mailmap
.spi.yml
.swift-format
.swiftformatignore
.unacceptablelanguageignore
